name: Pathways to Science (BC Children's Hospital Research Institute)
what_you_do: Join free online talks from researchers and health professionals about science and health careers. It is lecture style. Cameras and microphones stay off and you ask questions in the chat.
who_can_apply: Grade 11 and 12 students in BC and the Yukon. No research experience needed. Limited to the first 1,000 students who apply.
pay_detail: Free. You get a certificate of participation if you apply and attend 7 of the 10 sessions.
duration: 10 monthly online sessions, Sept 2026 to June 2027, about 1 hour each
deadline_text: Ten Monday sessions from Sept 2026 to June 2027 (Sept 21, 2026 is 6 to 7 p.m.; the others are 5 to 6 p.m.). No deadline is posted. You can sign up any time during the series until 1,000 students have applied.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online application. It asks for your name, contact details, grade and school. It asks for a parent or guardian's contact. It asks for one answer of 150 words or less. Say why you want to attend.
notes: Online talks only, not a job or hands-on lab work. This is in Canada, so British Columbia rules apply and this guide has not checked them. The institute says it does not offer any formal placements for students who want to volunteer, job shadow or gain work experience. The application form link is on the program page.
